about: Design-seed vocabulary (D-81, docs/styles/DISTINCTNESS_PLAN.md step 3). The essentials a lesson needs (labels, speech and thought bubbles, panels, icons, tick and cross marks) are never removed for having appeared before (D-80); each lesson draws them in its OWN treatment, chosen from its subject's material and away from the recent lessons. Read by loom/seed.py (choice) and runtime/treat.js (drawing). Edit by hand; the runtime's option lists must match (tests check).

shape.round: soft, generous corners; friendly and calm
shape.angular: chamfered corners and straight cuts; technical, urgent
shape.organic: edges that bulge slightly, no two alike; living things, people, growth
shape.architectural: square corners, a solid base; rules, institutions, structure

label.pill: a saturated pill with a pointer line and a dot on the part (the classic)
label.tag: a luggage tag tied to the part with a curved string
label.ribbon: a folded banner with forked tails
label.underline: plain words with a thick coloured underline that runs into a leader
label.stamp: a tilted double-ruled stamp, inked, no fill
label.flag: a swallowtail flag on a pole planted at the part

bubble.round: a rounded speech bubble with a curved tail (the classic)
bubble.comic: an inked, cut-cornered bubble with a sharp wedge tail
bubble.cloud: a scalloped cloud with trailing puffs
bubble.note: a sticky note taped up, tilted, with a folded corner
bubble.chat: a messaging-app bubble with one square corner and delivery dots
bubble.wobble: a hand-drawn uneven outline with a soft tail

panel.card: a filled card in the lesson's shape language (the classic)
panel.paper: a light sheet with a folded corner and faint rules
panel.glass: a translucent pane with a bright rim and a sheen
panel.frame: no fill: a double hairline with corner brackets, the title set into the rule
panel.cutout: a solid colour block with a hard offset shadow
panel.bare: no box at all: a short accent bar above the title, content on the ground

icon.disc: the icon knocked out of a coloured disc (the classic)
icon.bare: the icon alone, heavier, standing on a soft ground shadow
icon.tile: a raised tile with a hard shadow, icon in colour
icon.duotone: a soft colour blob behind, offset, icon in ink
icon.ring: an open ring with a gap and a bead, icon inside
icon.seal: a rosette seal, icon knocked out

mark.disc: tick or cross knocked out of a disc (the classic)
mark.box: a ruled box ticked by hand, the mark overflowing it
mark.brush: a thick tapered brush stroke, no container
mark.stamp: a tilted double-ringed stamp around the mark

texture.halftone: a dot screen fading out of one corner
texture.hatch: diagonal hatching in the shaded band

entrance.pop: things pop in with a little overshoot (the classic)
entrance.draw: things are drawn or wiped on, as if by hand
entrance.slide: things slide in from the side they relate to
entrance.unfold: panels unroll top to bottom, labels wipe, bubbles open from the speaker
entrance.drop: things drop in and land, panels settle
entrance.typeset: things fade up gently, labels wipe like type being set

camera.push: the camera pushes into the part that matters (guidance for the storyboard)
camera.pan: the camera pans along a process or a row (guidance for the storyboard)
camera.cut: cuts between held frames (guidance for the storyboard)

materials.reads_as: the body and wellbeing: soft, living, inside-out
money and finance: ledgers, coins, receipts
law, policy and compliance: documents, seals, structure
software, data and systems: screens, signals, precise edges
people, teams and conversation: warm, hand-made
safety, operations and the shop floor: signage, industrial
science and the natural world: organic forms, light
memory, learning and time: notebooks, calendars, steps
